---------------------------- MODULE W4Od1m6p5t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Runways, Controllers, Aircraft, MaxClock, LeaseDur, NoOne

VARIABLES owner, expiry, clock, cleared, clearLog


vars == <<owner, expiry, clock, cleared, clearLog>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Runways -> Controllers \cup {NoOne}]
    /\ expiry \in [Runways -> 0..MaxClock]
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxClock
    /\ cleared \subseteq Aircraft
    /\ clearLog \in Seq([ac: Aircraft, ct: Controllers, rw: Runways])

Init ==
    /\ owner = [r \in Runways |-> NoOne]
    /\ expiry = [r \in Runways |-> 0]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ cleared = {}
    /\ clearLog = << >>

ValidLease(c, r) == owner[r] = c /\ expiry[r] >= clock

AcquireLease(c, r) ==
    /\ (owner[r] = NoOne \/ expiry[r] < clock)
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![r] = c]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![r] = clock + LeaseDur]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, cleared, clearLog>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, cleared, clearLog>>

ClearTakeoff(c, r, a) ==
    /\ ValidLease(c, r)
    /\ a \notin cleared
    /\ cleared' = cleared \cup {a}
    /\ clearLog' = Append(clearLog, [ac |-> a, ct |-> c, rw |-> r])
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, clock>>

ReleaseLease(c, r) ==
    /\ owner[r] = c
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![r] = NoOne]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![r] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, cleared, clearLog>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, r \in Runways : AcquireLease(c, r)
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, r \in Runways, a \in Aircraft : ClearTakeoff(c, r, a)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, r \in Runways : ReleaseLease(c, r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AtMostOnce ==
    \A i, j \in DOMAIN clearLog :
        (clearLog[i].ac = clearLog[j].ac) => (i = j)

=============================================================================
nl:
An air-traffic control tower allocates a small set of runways to controllers using leases. A controller acquires a lease on a runway, which carries an expiry time; while the lease is valid (its expiry is at or after the current clock) the controller may issue a single, irreversible takeoff clearance to a waiting aircraft on that runway. Time advances in ticks, and a controller may be slow: it can hold a lease that quietly expires as the clock moves past it, so a stale lease must never be honored. Controllers may also voluntarily release a lease. A takeoff clearance is irreversible - once an aircraft is cleared it can never be cleared again, and every clearance is appended to an immutable clearance log recording the aircraft, the clearing controller, and the runway.

Actions: acquire a lease on a free or expired runway, advance the clock by one tick, issue a takeoff clearance under a valid lease, and release a held lease.

SAFETY PROPERTY: No aircraft is ever granted takeoff clearance more than once - each aircraft appears at most once across the entire clearance log.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od10m0p3t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Blocks, Trains, Instances, MaxVer, NoAtt, Free

VARIABLES owner, version, att, grants

vars == <<owner, version, att, grants>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Blocks -> Trains \cup {Free}]
    /\ version \in [Blocks -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ att \in [Instances -> ([b: Blocks, v: 0..MaxVer, t: Trains] \cup {NoAtt})]
    /\ grants \subseteq (Blocks \X Trains)

Init ==
    /\ owner = [b \in Blocks |-> Free]
    /\ version = [b \in Blocks |-> 0]
    /\ att = [i \in Instances |-> NoAtt]
    /\ grants = {}

BeginAttempt(i, b, t) ==
    /\ att[i] = NoAtt
    /\ att' = [att EXCEPT ![i] = [b |-> b, v |-> version[b], t |-> t]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, version, grants>>

Commit(i) ==
    /\ att[i] # NoAtt
    /\ LET a == att[i] IN
        /\ version[a.b] = a.v
        /\ owner[a.b] = Free
        /\ version[a.b] < MaxVer
        /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![a.b] = a.t]
        /\ version' = [version EXCEPT ![a.b] = version[a.b] + 1]
        /\ grants' = grants \cup {<<a.b, a.t>>}
    /\ att' = [att EXCEPT ![i] = NoAtt]

AbortRetry(i) ==
    /\ att[i] # NoAtt
    /\ att[i].v # version[att[i].b]
    /\ att' = [att EXCEPT ![i] = NoAtt]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, version, grants>>

Refresh(i) ==
    /\ att[i] # NoAtt
    /\ att' = [att EXCEPT ![i] = [att[i] EXCEPT !.v = version[att[i].b]]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, version, grants>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances, b \in Blocks, t \in Trains : BeginAttempt(i, b, t)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Commit(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : AbortRetry(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Refresh(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A b \in Blocks : \A t1, t2 \in Trains :
        (<<b, t1>> \in grants /\ <<b, t2>> \in grants) => (t1 = t2)

=============================================================================
nl:
A subway signalling system guards track blocks so that no block is ever allocated to two trains at once. Two independent signalling instances draw from one shared pool of blocks. Each instance uses optimistic locking: it begins an attempt by reading a block's current version number, then later tries to commit the allocation. A commit succeeds only if the version it read still matches the block's live version and the block is still free; on success the block is granted to the train, the version is bumped, and the grant is recorded in a shared ledger. If an instance discovers its read version is stale, it may abort and retry, and it may also refresh its pending attempt by re-reading the current version before committing.

Actions: begin an attempt by reading a version, commit an attempt via version-matched compare-and-set, abort-and-retry a stale attempt, and refresh a pending attempt with the current version.

SAFETY PROPERTY: No track block is ever recorded as granted to two different trains in the shared ledger.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od15m7p5t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Participants, MaxReg, MaxPrice, Collect, Open

VARIABLES phase, reg, bid, crashed, printLog

vars == <<phase, reg, bid, crashed, printLog>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in {Collect, Open}
    /\ reg \in 0..MaxReg
    /\ bid \in [Participants -> 0..MaxPrice]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Participants
    /\ printLog \in Seq([by: Participants, ver: 0..MaxReg])

Init ==
    /\ phase = Collect
    /\ reg = 0
    /\ bid = [p \in Participants |-> 0]
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ printLog = << >>

SubmitBid(p, pr) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ bid' = [bid EXCEPT ![p] = pr]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, reg, crashed, printLog>>

WithdrawBid(p) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ bid[p] # 0
    /\ bid' = [bid EXCEPT ![p] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, reg, crashed, printLog>>

Crash(p) ==
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ crashed' = {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, reg, bid, printLog>>

CasOpen(p) ==
    /\ phase = Collect
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ reg < MaxReg
    /\ phase' = Open
    /\ printLog' = Append(printLog, [by |-> p, ver |-> reg])
    /\ reg' = reg + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bid, crashed>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Participants, pr \in 1..MaxPrice : SubmitBid(p, pr)
    \/ \E p \in Participants : WithdrawBid(p)
    \/ \E p \in Participants : Crash(p)
    \/ \E p \in Participants : CasOpen(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OpenOnce ==
    /\ (phase = Open) => (Len(printLog) = 1)
    /\ (phase = Collect) => (printLog = << >>)

    Participants = {p1, p2, p3}
    MaxReg = 3
    MaxPrice = 2
    Collect = Collect
    Open = Open

nl:
A stock exchange runs an opening auction. Matching-engine participants submit and may withdraw indicative bids as the book evolves. A shared compare-and-swap register governs the single irreversible transition from collecting to open: exactly one participant may win the CAS that opens the market, which prints the opening trade into an immutable print log and bumps the register. At most one participant may crash silently - it simply stops taking any further steps - and this must never allow the opening print to be produced twice. Once the market is open, no further opening print may be produced, though the remaining participants continue adjusting their bids.

Actions: submit a bid, withdraw a bid, crash a single participant silently, and win the compare-and-swap that opens the market and prints the single opening trade.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The opening trade is printed at most once - when the market is open the print log holds exactly one entry, and while still collecting it is empty.

CONSTANTS Rooms, MsgIds, Total, MaxEpoch

VARIABLES roomLoad, freePool, transit, epoch, msgs

vars == <<roomLoad, freePool, transit, epoch, msgs>>

RECURSIVE Sum(_)
Sum(S) == IF S = {} THEN 0
          ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN roomLoad[x] + Sum(S \ {x})

TypeOK ==
    /\ roomLoad \in [Rooms -> 0..Total]
    /\ freePool \in 0..Total
    /\ transit \in 0..Total
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ msgs \subseteq (MsgIds \X Rooms)

Init ==
    /\ roomLoad = [r \in Rooms |-> 0]
    /\ freePool = Total
    /\ transit = 0
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ msgs = {}

SendSchedule(id, r) ==
    /\ freePool > 0
    /\ \A rr \in Rooms : <<id, rr>> \notin msgs
    /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {<<id, r>>}
    /\ freePool' = freePool - 1
    /\ transit' = transit + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<roomLoad, epoch>>

Deliver(id, r) ==
    /\ <<id, r>> \in msgs
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {<<id, r>>}
    /\ transit' = transit - 1
    /\ roomLoad' = [roomLoad EXCEPT ![r] = roomLoad[r] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<freePool, epoch>>

Discharge(r) ==
    /\ roomLoad[r] > 0
    /\ roomLoad' = [roomLoad EXCEPT ![r] = roomLoad[r] - 1]
    /\ freePool' = freePool + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<transit, epoch, msgs>>

Reconfigure(r1, r2) ==
    /\ r1 # r2
    /\ roomLoad[r1] > 0
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ roomLoad' = [roomLoad EXCEPT ![r1] = roomLoad[r1] - 1, ![r2] = roomLoad[r2] + 1]
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<freePool, transit, msgs>>

Next ==
    \/ \E id \in MsgIds, r \in Rooms : SendSchedule(id, r)
    \/ \E id \in MsgIds, r \in Rooms : Deliver(id, r)
    \/ \E r \in Rooms : Discharge(r)
    \/ \E r1 \in Rooms, r2 \in Rooms : Reconfigure(r1, r2)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Conservation == Sum(Rooms) + freePool + transit = Total

    MsgIds = {m1, m2}
    Total = 3
    MaxEpoch = 3

A hospital operating-room scheduler manages a fixed total number of anesthesia units shared between operating rooms and a free pool. Scheduling a patient into a room sends a reservation message that pulls one unit from the free pool into transit; because the message bus may reorder messages, reservation messages are delivered in any order, and delivery moves the in-transit unit into the target room. Discharging a patient returns one unit from a room back to the free pool. The scheduler is periodically reconfigured under a monotonically increasing epoch number, which rebalances load by moving one unit directly from one room to another. No path ever creates or destroys an anesthesia unit.

Actions: send a scheduling reservation, deliver a reservation message (possibly out of order), discharge a patient, and reconfigure under a new epoch.

A warehouse robot fleet allocates shelf slots using two-phase commit. A coordinator proposes assigning a free slot to a robot, which opens a voting round and resets every resource-manager participant's vote. Participants then cast yes or no votes; a participant may be slow, casting its vote late, but it never fails outright. The coordinator commits only when every participant has voted yes and the slot is still free, recording the assignment in an allocation ledger and marking the slot owned. If the round cannot commit - some participant voted no, or the slot is no longer free - the coordinator aborts and returns to idle, ready to propose again.

nl:
A print-shop spooler holds a fixed set of print jobs. Two independent spooler instances share one unassigned-job pool, coordinating through a single compare-and-swap register that acts as a claim lock. An instance claims work by winning the CAS on the register (moving it from free to the instance's own id) and pulling one job from the shared pool into its private queue; it releases the lock by CAS-ing the register back to free. An instance prints a queued job, moving it to its completed count, requeues a job back to the shared pool, or reprints a completed job by returning it to the shared pool. Jobs are never created or destroyed - every job is always somewhere: the pool, some instance's queue, or its completed count.

    /\ UNCHANGED <<carsAt, lot, finished>>

    /\ UNCHANGED <<carsAt, lot, finished>>

            /\ finished' = finished + 1

    /\ lot' = lot - 1
    /\ carsAt' = [carsAt EXCEPT ![1] = carsAt[1] + 1]

A car-wash conveyor line has several wash stations arranged in a ring. Exclusive permission to advance a car is granted by a single token that circulates around the ring; only the station currently holding the token may push one of its cars forward to the next station, and the final station's advance sends the car out finished. Cars enter the line from a waiting lot into the first station. Normally the token is passed hand-to-hand to the next station in ring order, but a privileged admin override may seize the token and hand it directly to any station. No car is ever created or lost - each car is always in the waiting lot, at some station, or finished.

To dispatch a request the controller opens a voting round for a request that has not already been dispatched; the currently active cars each cast a yes or no vote.     /\ version \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ attempt \in [Workers -> (0..MaxVer) \cup {NoRead}]
    /\ inCS \in [Workers -> BOOLEAN]

    /\ owner = Free
    /\ version = 0
    /\ attempt = [w \in Workers |-> NoRead]
    /\ inCS = [w \in Workers |-> FALSE]

BeginTry(w) ==
    /\ attempt[w] = NoRead
    /\ ~inCS[w]
    /\ attempt' = [attempt EXCEPT ![w] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, version, inCS>>

EnterCS(w) ==

    /\ owner = Free
    /\ owner' = w
    /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![w] = TRUE]
    /\ attempt' = [attempt EXCEPT ![w] = NoRead]
    /\ UNCHANGED version

    /\ owner' = Free
    /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![w] = FALSE]
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % (MaxVer + 1)

    /\ log = << >>

\* Coordinator opens the prepare phase of the two-phase commit for a block.
BeginVote(b) ==
    /\ phase[b] = "idle"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![b] = "voting"]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![b] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fired, log>>

\* A participant records its prepare vote. Participants may be slow (voting late)
\* but are never treated as failed: commit strictly waits for every one of them.
CastVote(b, pt) ==
    /\ phase[b] = "voting"
    /\ pt \notin votes[b]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![b] = votes[b] \cup {pt}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, fired, log>>

\* Commit only once all participants -- including any slow one -- have voted.
CommitDecide(b) ==
    /\ phase[b] = "voting"
    /\ votes[b] = Participants
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![b] = "committed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, fired, log>>

\* The coordinator may abort a pending round instead of committing.
AbortDecide(b) ==
    /\ phase[b] = "voting"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![b] = "aborted"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, fired, log>>

\* The irreversible action: dispatch a train into a committed block. It is a
\* permanent one-shot -- the fired latch blocks it from ever happening again.
Dispatch(b) ==
    /\ phase[b] = "committed"
    /\ fired[b] = FALSE
    /\ fired' = [fired EXCEPT ![b] = TRUE]
    /\ log' = Append(log, b)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, votes>>

\* Recycle a settled block's protocol slot for a fresh round; the fired latch
\* is left untouched, so an already-dispatched block can never be dispatched anew.
Recycle(b) ==
    /\ phase[b] \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![b] = "idle"]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![b] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fired, log>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : BeginVote(b)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks, pt \in Participants : CastVote(b, pt)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : CommitDecide(b)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : AbortDecide(b)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : Dispatch(b)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : Recycle(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Irreversible-at-most-once: no block is ever dispatched twice; each block
\* appears at most once in the permanent dispatch log.
DispatchedAtMostOnce == \A i, j \in DOMAIN log : log[i] = log[j] => i = j

nl:
A subway signalling block system dispatches trains into track blocks, and each dispatch is
gated by a two-phase commit across the interlocking participants. To clear a block, the
coordinator opens a prepare round; each participant casts its prepare vote. The participants
may be slow -- one can lag and vote late -- but none is ever treated as failed: the
coordinator commits only once every participant, including any slow one, has voted, and it
may instead abort a round. Dispatching a train into a committed block is the irreversible
action of the system: it is a permanent one-shot, latched so that a block once dispatched can
never be dispatched again. Every dispatch is recorded in a permanent append-only signalling
log. A block whose round has settled (committed or aborted) may be recycled for a fresh
prepare round, but recycling leaves the dispatch latch untouched, so an already-dispatched
block is never dispatched a second time.

Actions: BeginVote (open the prepare phase), CastVote (a participant records its prepare
vote), CommitDecide (commit once all participants have voted), AbortDecide (abort the round),
Dispatch (the irreversible one-shot train dispatch into a committed block, appended to the
log), Recycle (return a settled block to idle without clearing its dispatch latch).

SAFETY PROPERTY: No block is ever dispatched more than once; each block appears at most once
in the permanent dispatch log.
